{{Quote|That's pirate territory.''"<br />"''It's odd, though. The shipping in this area is mostly agricultural, or mineral, or supplies for subsistence settlements. Not much in the way of luxury goods or shipments of currency. What's attracting the pirates here?''"<br />"''Could be a lot of things, but this Arnot Station looks legit. Lots of small and medium freighter traffic, a couple of bigger local shipping lines, no Imperials. Davit's merchants must have picked it. It's probably where they do most of their business.''"<br />"''Good. Maybe we're due a safe port.''"<br />"''Yeah, the universe doesn't work like that.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="RE" />}}
The '''Arnot Station system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained several inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that all had small agricultural settlements. [[Arnot Station]] was situated on the outskirts of the system.<ref name="RE" />
